policies.label: Privileged teacher / platform aligned
policies.timestamp_basis: Source snapshot time; no trained weights.
policies.historical_qualification: Reference only; independently scored against the same physical environment.

privileged_teacher.name: Simulator-assisted teacher reference; no neural network
privileged_teacher.vision: Exact currently visible instance pixels, range/resolution gates and sustained evidence
privileged_teacher.control: Visible-target privileged deck pose → platform-aligned smooth controller → PX4
privileged_teacher.note: A privileged reference, not an unaided learned policy.

radio_pose.name: Recurrent radio/visual pose checkpoint
radio_pose.note: This schema spans multiple fusion architectures. The full policy architecture receipt and source, not the schema alone, identify the exact network.

radio_conditioned.name: Quality-conditioned recurrent radio/visual pose + geometric control
radio_conditioned.memory: GRU(320,128); absolute visual Linear(128,6) and inherited pose heads
radio_conditioned.radio: Validity/age/uncertainty-aware recurrent input; this predates independent visual recurrence and bounded fusion gates
radio_conditioned.control: Learned pose estimates, marker registration, explicit controller and PX4

radio_robust.name: Recurrent visual pose + bounded radio fusion + geometric control
radio_robust.vision: MobileNetV3-Small; spatial feature summaries; visual projection 1728 → 256
radio_robust.state: 15 pose/contact values; inherited six-action head is not the executed control path
radio_robust.radio: Separate 13 → 48 → 2 fusion MLP; position/velocity blend bounded to 0.35
radio_robust.control: Marker registration, explicit guarded velocity/yaw/gimbal control, real PX4
radio_robust.note: Spatial and acquisition heads differ by revision. Per-model frozen source receipts are authoritative.

recognizer.name: Dense boat discriminator + RGB object verifier
recognizer.input: MobileNet fine/context features plus candidate RGB crops (96 × 96)
recognizer.output: Target / wrong design / unknown logits; marker confidence
recognizer.note: A recognition checkpoint alone is not a flight policy. rgb_only/residual is checkpoint metadata.

marker.name: Historical learned pose + marker geometry controller
marker.note: Original pose schema; retained as inventory. Runtime source is incomplete locally for this bundle.

spatial.name: Image-only spatial boat/pad acquisition head
spatial.fine_context: 24-channel fine and 48-channel context maps → separate 1×1 Conv to 24 channels each
spatial.merge: Concatenate 48 channels → two 3×3 Conv(48,48) blocks; heatmap, subcell offset, presence heads
spatial.note: Component only, no standalone flight controller.

acquisition.name: Global-feature acquisition MLP
acquisition.note: Visibility and image-centre acquisition component; distinct from the spatial CNN head.

onnx.name: Exported pose inference graph
onnx.note: Browser inference component. Export does not include the complete controller/search/PX4 stack.

unweighted_architectures.name: Historical action policy: MobileNetV3-Small + 32→64→64 telemetry + GRU(320,128) → 6 actions / 10 auxiliaries
unweighted_architectures.status: Source present; no matching aerodock.landing.checkpoint.v1 weights found locally

inventory.archives: Archived checkpoint bytes are deduplicated and inspected without loading a model; full archived flight pipelines are not automatically promoted.
